subject: Thanks for the call — Private/VPC architecture review (scheduling)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood-inference.com>
To: Tom Kelly <tom.kelly@apexhealth.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the call — next steps: Private/VPC architecture review

Hi Tom / Alyssa,

Thanks again for taking time today — good discussion and very helpful context on your security and network constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: Apex Health is most interested in a Private/VPC deployment with customer-managed VPC peering, KMS integration, and an option for on-prem air-gapped nodes for PHI workloads. You have strict firewall rules and need a deterministic maintenance window.
- Ask from us: schedule a technical architecture review with your network/SRE folks to walk through the VPC peering pattern, routing, and encryption keyflow.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue, Mar 9 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Wed, Mar 10 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT

Please let me know which works or share a preferred window and who from your side will join (network lead, security, infra). I attached a short proposal and a first-draft network diagram to help frame the discussion.

Attachments: redwood-private-architecture-proposal.pdf, network-diagram.png

Thanks — I can send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Tom Kelly <tom.kelly@apexhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@apexhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for the call — next steps: Private/VPC architecture review

Marissa — thanks for the recap. Both slots look good; can we do Tue, Mar 9 at 10:00 AM PT? That works best for the team.

Attendees from Apex: Alyssa (cloud infra), Samir Patel (network lead) — Samir will be the primary technical contact for peering and firewall rules. He may want to share our current ACLs ahead of the call.

If you need anything else before then, let us know.

—Tom
Tom Kelly
Head of Platform, Apex Health
Tom.Kelly@apexhealth.com

Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Thanks for the call — next steps: Private/VPC architecture review

Adding a quick internal note:

We should plan to have Dev (principal infra architect) and Logan (SRE lead) on the call — they can cover peering, VPN options, and the on-prem air-gapped deployment pattern. I can prep a short 10-min runbook of questions to drive the architecture session (firewall rules, allowed CIDR ranges, KMS policies, audit log endpoints).

Also flagging that we may want to propose a two-hour deep dive if Samir wants to show ACLs and current routing — will confirm with the customer before extending.

Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com

Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Private/VPC architecture review — Tue, Mar 9 10:00 AM PT

Great — thanks all. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Agenda (30–60 min):
- 10:00–10:10 — intros + goals (Marissa / Tom)
- 10:10–10:30 — network peering & firewall constraints (Samir + Logan)
- 10:30–10:45 — KMS & keyflow (Dev)
- 10:45–11:00 — next steps & action items (all)

Samir — if you can share a redacted copy of your ACL export ahead of the meeting that would help us prepare. We will keep the session focused on actionable decisions (peering topology, required routes, ports, and KMS access patterns).

Attachments: redwood-private-architecture-proposal.pdf, network-diagram.png

Looking forward — I added a short pre-read to the invite and will share the runbook Neha mentioned if the team wants it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
